Customer — Withholding tax receivable

This screen displays withholding tax receivable transactions for a specific customer.

When customers deduct withholding tax from their payments to you, these amounts appear here as receivables that can be claimed as tax credits from the government.

Each transaction shows the date, description, and amount of withholding tax that was deducted from your income.

You can use the New Receipt button to record when you receive credit for these withheld amounts or when they are applied against your tax obligations.

Learn more about recording withholding tax receipts: Withholding tax receipt — Edit
